sentences.text: The parents' room felt cold, staying at 17.3 °C at 00:00.
The living room reached 16.7 °C at 05:30, and the bathroom was 17.7 °C at 05:10.
Since all these rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, remember that the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Because of the low temperatures shown in C1, C2, and C3, perhaps checking the heating might help keep things cozy.
